_comment: The neutral containers of jailbreak/obfuscation/neutral_container.py: one pool per container, eight variants each, every one an everyday document with the prompt in its {prompt} slot. The surroundings are neutral by design: no instruction, no word to the reader, nothing about answering. In code_comment and yaml_document, what stands before {prompt} on its line (a comment marker, an indent) is put before every other line of the prompt too; in csv_row the prompt is a quoted field, the delimiter the character before {prompt}; in transcript_line and log_entry the prompt ends the document.
